findings.title: Decision service runs out of threads
findings.message: It holds a thread for 260 ms per request (250 ms waiting on Partner scoring API). At 400 req/s it needs 104 threads; it has 64 (4 replicas × 16).

fix.label: Scale on busy threads
fix.needsChoice: Its edit ops are too long for this reply: make the change with edit_diagram.

findings.title: Decision service scales on CPU, but its threads wait
findings.message: At full load it uses 31% CPU against a 70% target while the backlog grows. A same-seed rerun confirmed scaling on busy threads.

fix.label: Scale on busy threads
fix.needsChoice: Its edit ops are too long for this reply: make the change with edit_diagram.

findings.title: No timeout on the call to Partner scoring API
findings.message: If it stalls, every thread waits.
